records.title: LongVU-TTT: Causal Test-Time Training for Visual Resampling in Long Video Understanding
records.reason: The paper is a video-MLLM resampling study with a visual-token bottleneck, but its reported efficiency optimization is for training rather than reduced LLM inference cost.

records.title: Beam Search, Self-Consistency, and the Limits of Inference-Time Scaling for Grammar-Constrained Text-to-SQL in Small Language Models
records.reason: The study analyzes inference-time compute budgets for grammar-constrained SQL generation, but its contribution is a task-specific accuracy tradeoff rather than a general inference-efficiency method.

records.title: LocalLSTC: A Long Short-Term Control Architecture for Locally Deployed GUI Agents
records.reason: LocalLSTC studies a control architecture for locally deployed GUI agents and weaker reasoning backbones; the abstract does not claim inference-efficiency improvements.

records.title: Loss-Based Active Learning for Neural Abstractive Summarization
records.reason: LOBSTER is an active-learning method for selecting training annotations for summarization; this is training-data efficiency, outside scope.

records.title: Controlling for Omitted Variable Bias in Deep Neural Networks
records.reason: The work proposes confound control for deep neural-network predictions and is not about LLM inference/serving.
